missionPremise: Cloud Run cannot override command. atoms-writer-job.mjs hardcodes scripts/write-cad-parcel-roll-county.mjs and sets CAD_PARCEL_ROLL_PATH=1 unconditionally. That is why four of five writers have no job form. Factory WRITER_JOBS naming f11-setback is a stub, not a job. The setback writer does not exist. Conformant stage-and-merge, city-scoped, refuse on unresolved binding. Apply is held. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-31_f11-writer_dispatch.md; write-path read of atoms-writer-job.mjs 2026-08-31T14:32Z; OPS-19 F-11 F-02.
completionPredicate: Allowlist keyed by writer name; unknown or absent writer name refuses non-zero with a named reason and never defaults to CAD. CAD_PARCEL_ROLL_PATH is a property of the selected writer. --name=value and spaced forms both parse. Missing county refuses. Off-default execution reads run scope back. Setback writer exists, city-scoped, conformant chunked stage-and-merge, refuses missing county / unresolved binding / unnamed rule set / unresolvable district. Never not-applicable on an in-city parcel. Negative runs prove allowlist and county parse refuse. No --apply. Diff in the registered worktree. Planner commits.
scopeBasis: hauska-engine this clone only. Item 1 first (unlocks four writers). Item 2 the setback writer. Item 3 easement live-fetch is optional and may be handed back. Factory allowlist is out of this card. Do not apply.

adversarial.claim: Factory WRITER_JOBS.f11-setback is the allowlist this card needs
adversarial.finding: That map is a Factory CLI gate. Cloud Run starts the engine image whose entrypoint is atoms-writer-job.mjs. A named stub does not select a child script.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: add another Factory id and stop; rejected by the write-path read of the engine job

adversarial.claim: Default the writer name to cad-parcel-roll so existing jobs keep working
adversarial.finding: A silent default is how a job runs the wrong writer against a named county and reports success. Existing factory-atoms-cad must pass an explicit writer name (or a documented env that is itself an allowlist key), never an implicit CAD default.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: keep today's hardcoded child as the no-flag path; rejected by the dispatch fail-closed rule

adversarial.claim: A county-wide setback owe is acceptable for the first writer
adversarial.finding: Counties do not zone unincorporated land. Unincorporated is not-applicable structurally. In-city with no table is unmeasured then absent-verified. Never not-applicable on an in-city parcel.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: copy write-cad-parcel-roll-county county loop; rejected as a category error

allowlist.what: Export a frozen WRITER_ALLOWLIST from atoms-writer-job.mjs (or a sibling module it imports). Each entry: id, script path under packages/engine-core/scripts/, pathEnv (the PATH=1 guard the child requires) or null, planRow. Select by --writer= or WRITER_NAME. Unknown or absent refuses WRITER_REQUIRED / WRITER_NOT_ALLOWLISTED. Never default to CAD.
allowlist.bypasses: direct node scripts/write-*.mjs (named; those still require their PATH=1 guard)

countyParse.what: Parse --county=value and --county value. Refuse COUNTY_REQUIRED when absent. Echo resolved {writer, county, pathEnv, script} before spawn so an off-default Cloud Run execution can be read back from the log.
countyParse.bypasses: a child that defaults its own county (must also refuse; prove on the setback writer)

pathEnvProperty.what: CAD_PARCEL_ROLL_PATH is set only when the selected writer declares it. WELL_FACT_PATH / BUILDING_FOOTPRINT_PATH / any setback guard follow the same rule. Unconditional CAD_PARCEL_ROLL_PATH=1 is the defect.
pathEnvProperty.fails: selected writer missing its own guard when the child requires one
pathEnvProperty.bypasses: invoking the child without the job

setbackWriter.what: write-setback-county.mjs (or city-scoped name) modeled on existing writers, conformant design: ordered chunked slices, run_event per chunk, batched links, lease v2 with the row locked in the chunk transaction. Scope is city (jurisdiction binding), not county-wide zoning. Unincorporated -> not-applicable. In-city no table -> unmeasured then absent-verified. Refuse: missing county, unresolved binding, unnamed rule source, unresolvable district. Do not adopt placeholder setback-rule atoms (storage-port-proof/phase-1a) or McLennan envelopes from 0 rules. Name any collision.
setbackWriter.executes: the new script dry-run path plus unit tests
setbackWriter.fails: named refuse codes; no emit on unresolved input
setbackWriter.bypasses: old-shape --apply (forbidden; this card does not apply)

falsifiers.allowlistAbsent: atoms-writer-job with no --writer and no WRITER_NAME must exit non-zero WRITER_REQUIRED. If it runs CAD, the card failed.
falsifiers.allowlistUnknown: --writer=not-a-writer must exit non-zero WRITER_NOT_ALLOWLISTED. If it falls through to CAD, the card failed.
falsifiers.pathEnvNotConstant: selecting well-fact must not set CAD_PARCEL_ROLL_PATH=1; selecting cad-parcel-roll must set only that writer's env.
falsifiers.setbackCityScope: a county-only invocation that would emit in-city setbacks without a city binding must refuse.
falsifiers.placeholderAdopt: feeding a placeholder setback-rule atom as input must refuse or name the collision, never write.

threeQuestionGate.control: COUNTY_REQUIRED on equals and spaced forms
threeQuestionGate.bypasses: child that defaults county (must also refuse)
